source.dataset_name: Operating Dataset of Liquid Hydrogen Refueling Station
source.declared_scope: 35 MPa dispensers, 90 MPa compressor, high-pressure storage banks, liquid-hydrogen pump and storage tank

evaluation.purpose: public station-side intake and fixed-model eligibility screen
eligibility_rules: The file must be downloadable from the public record and match the catalogued file identity and byte count.
A usable time axis must parse without calendar-date substitution and contain at least two ordered observations.
At least one declared station-side pressure and temperature channel must be present with finite numeric values.
A flow or cumulative-mass channel is required for a fueling/recharge replay candidate; pressure-only files remain intake diagnostics.
Unit interpretation must be supported by the public data description; unverified unit conversion disqualifies numerical scoring.
Liquid-hydrogen pump/tank channels are retained as a domain-boundary diagnostic and cannot be scored by the gaseous-H70 station model without an explicit phase-compatible boundary.
No vehicle, receptacle, common-clock station-to-vehicle channel or controller-state claim may be inferred from this dataset.
evaluation.claim_limit: A positive result would support only a public station-side component screen. A negative or ineligible result does not invalidate the runtime model; it records a dataset-boundary limitation. No full-loop, vehicle, site-distance, accident-frequency or operator-effectiveness claim is permitted.
